xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex:
The Board of Directors has an appropriate mix of Functional Directors, Government Nominee Directors and Non-Executive Independent Directors. BHEL's Board structure consists of 16 (sixteen) directors comprising Chairman & Managing Director, 5 Whole-time Directors (Functional Directors), 2 Government Nominees and 8 Non-Executive (Independent) Directors. It is submitted that as on 31.12.2025, BHEL Board consists of seven (7) Non-IDs and Three (3) IDs. There is a shortfall of Four(4) IDs on the Board of BHEL.
The matter of filling up of these vacancies is under process at the end of Government of India.
